articles.summary: MCLEAN, Va.–(BUSINESS WIRE)– AIRO Group Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: AIRO), a next-generation aerospace and defense company, in combination with Sky-Watch A/S, its wholly owned subsidiary, today announced the public unveiling of its RQ-70, a new deep-reach intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR) drone, extending ISR capabilities beyond the immediate tactical frontline. The announcement was made at Eurosatory 2026, […]
articles.title: AIRO Debuts RQ-70 Long-Range ISR Drone Platform at Eurosatory 2026, Advancing Multi-Product Growth Strategy
